_comment: AI-Search Hunter input (Goal League S1, owner aisearch). Read only by tools/build-aisearch.mjs, which writes: <title>, meta description, og:title and og:description for the slugs in pages{} (and, where "ld": true, the page's own WebPage JSON-LD name, description and about); the AISEARCH:ANSWER block on /indices; and data/aisearch-llms.txt, which tools/build-llms.mjs puts into llms.txt only (llms-full.txt is untouched). Tokens in descriptions: {level} {date} {priced} {base} {since} {cost} {month}, filled from the page's ticker in data/indices.json. No eBay URLs, prices or asks here, ever (R45).

indices.title: Is the Pokémon Card Market Up or Down? Every Set's Price Index, Dated
indices.description: Is the Pokémon card market up or down? Each set we track is one number, re-marked from dated sold prices and set to 100 at a base month, with its week, month and 3-month move. Pokémon sets from Base Set to the 30th Celebration, plus the 2026 1st Bowman Chrome Auto indices. No buy or sell calls.
